snippet.title: The Dead Await | 1.0 Release Date Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Survive the outbreak or become part of it. 
The Dead Await reaches its full 1.0 launch on May 18➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393580/The_Dead_Await/

Build your deck and try to survive in The Dead Await, a deck-building RPG set during a zombie apocalypse. As one of many survivors, set out across the desolate world, discover the truth about the outbreak, and rebuild human civilization - or die trying.

Jump into Early Access today and prepare for a brutal fight for survival in a world overrun by the infected.

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q

#indiegames #zombiesurvival #survivalgame
